verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page says Rovo AI identifies trends in work data to surface opportunities and bottlenecks, and breaks big ideas into actionable tasks with suggested assignment. This is first-party AI insight and suggestion inside the product. The evidence is only one-line marketing claims, with no detailed documentation or hands-on corroboration of how good or deep the insights are. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights Rovo generates and from which data, examples of in-product suggestion surfaces, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to identify trends to surface new opportunities and remove bottle necks.
Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
